name: epiccontext
description: Epic Context in every session: the project's context over MCP, the skills that say how to work with it, and hooks that fetch a briefing before UI work.

project_id.title: Epic Context project id
project_id.description: The project this repo works on (Project settings → Connect AI tools shows it). The hooks use it to put the project's anchor, orientation and briefings in front of the agent.

api_key.title: Epic Context API key
api_key.description: A read key for that project, used only by the hooks. The MCP connection itself signs in with your account.
